formula: Equal-weight mean over240 seed/epoch allocations; relative change100*(PAEG_mean/rarity_mean-1); variability is simulation variability, not an independent performance CI
go_paeg_cat: Not justified in the tested form: incremental hard-positive exposure about 1%, source-frequency total variation 0.75% (ordered plans differ 4.39%), moderate in-sample checkpoint stability and unresolved annotation noise.
preferred_future_comparison_for_student_: Preserved standard versus full-image patient-aware rarity-only sampling; no automatic redesign/freeze
redesign: Not required by sampler feasibility, since rarity exposure is substantial and all guardrails pass. Reconsider only through a separately approved scope if contribution/clinical rationale requires it.
simplify_rarity_only: Preferred: material rare-class exposure shifts with matched diversity/compute and no teacher-difficulty dependency; AP benefit remains unmeasured.
total_variation_unit: Normalized source-image frequency, not ordered positions
